svg.title: mindforgewr — Mindforge independent workshop
svg.desc: The lowercase mindforgewr name is drawn in warm ivory square pixels inside a dark terminal. Claude, a joyful terracotta pixel creature, plays guitar while Codex, a mint headphone-wearing robot, plays drums. In this 36-second comedy, scripted dialogue jokes about a failed test. Claude winds up and throws a yellow pixel bug at Codex, who bats it straight back with a paddle. The harmless bug bounces off a cross-eyed Claude and drops away. They dash into a tumbling cartoon dust cloud, with hands, feet, stars and dust particles popping out. The dust settles and a mechanic’s wrench drops safely between them, prompting a high five and a scripted tests-passed message before they return to music. From his corner, Claude raises and tosses a spinning mechanic's wrench, saying test passed. Codex ducks as it passes above him and lands safely to his right. Then the discarded bug hops back wearing a tiny top hat, takes the spotlight and plays a triangle. The surprised musicians welcome their new bandmate: it's a feature. Built with intention. mindforgewr.com. Human-led, AI-assisted.

g.aria-label: Claude goes cross-eyed at the returned bug
Claude stays in his corner, winds up and throws a mechanic's wrench

A mechanic's wrench spins from Claude's corner, passes above Codex and lands beside him
Claude and Codex notice the unexpected third musician
The same yellow bug hops back and joins the band on triangle
